result_text:
I changed `exportJson` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so `all_files.zip` no longer uses fixed file names. It now builds each entry name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call that writes the loose `aspect_*.txt` files. It reads each file back under that name, for the main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other aspects, in that order.

The default names and order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` as the aspect name, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The old code threw because it couldn't find the fixed `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, which is why `git-history.zip` was skipped too. With the lookup fixed, `git-history.zip` is written again whenever a `git-history.txt` exists.

I compiled the module and ran its `DataExport*` tests, and they passed. I didn't run a report with a renamed aspect to check the zip contents. `LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 280–284) still uses the same fixed `aspect_*.txt` names. I left it alone because it wasn't part of this task, but it will have the same problem with a renamed aspect.
